cells: Conduct examinations for All India Services and Central Services
Consulted on disciplinary cases affecting civil servants
Assist in framing and amendment of service rules

blocks.content: The UPSC is the central recruiting agency in India and acts as the watchdog of the merit system.

rows: Methods of recruitment to civil services and civil posts
Reservations of appointments or posts for backward classes
Principles for making appointments, promotions, and transfers
Claims of SCs/STs for consideration in civil service appointments
Disciplinary matters affecting civil servants in a civil capacity
Selection for chairmanship or membership of commissions and tribunals

items: UPSC is not consulted on matters regarding reservations for backward classes or claims of SCs/STs in civil posts.
Service conditions, pay scale, and training are managed by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), not UPSC.
If the government disagrees with UPSC advice, the non-acceptance must be approved by the Cabinet Committee on Appointments.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: UPSC conducts examinations for appointments to the civil services of the Union and All India Services.
It is consulted on all disciplinary matters affecting a person serving under the Government of India in a civil capacity.
The Commission advises on claims for reimbursement of legal expenses incurred by civil servants in defending legal proceedings.
The recommendations made by the UPSC are purely advisory and not binding on the government.
The President can exclude specific posts or matters from the purview of the UPSC by framing regulations.
